scope.evidence: All hunks serve the task: the notifier (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php), its config (config/services.php:37-39), logging channels (config/logging.php:57,76-82), env/test pinning (.env.example, phpunit.xml:30), docs (docs/ops/logging.md), CHANGELOG.md:16, and tests. issues.explanation: Both failure-path tests only assert that Log::error was called once; neither checks that the webhook URL is absent from the logged message/context (nor that the status code is included), so the secret-scrubbing requirement is not actually verified.
The stack assertion passes because phpunit.xml:30 pins LOG_STACK=daily; it does not exercise the new config default, so the test would still pass if the default in config/logging.php stayed 'single'.
The audit-write test ends with expect(true)->toBeTrue(), which cannot fail; it should assert that the audit entry was actually written (for example by spying on the channel or checking the log file).
The new public send() method (and the class) has no PHPDoc, while conventions.md:102 asks for PHPDoc on public methods touched.

review.summary: The change adds App\Ops\DiscordOpsAlert, the daily/audit logging lanes, the LOG_STACK=daily default, the required env/config keys, a docs/ops/logging.md decision guide, and Pest coverage. The implementation meets the task contract, including redaction, 1800-character truncation and soft-fail handling, but the failure-path tests do not assert the URL scrubbing they are named for and the audit-write test asserts nothing. With those tests tightened I would approve; the remaining item is a missing PHPDoc on the new public method.
